findings.quoted_text: Work Product, and every right in it, vests in Client as it is generated.
Work Product, and every right in it, vests in Client as it is generated.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work passes to the client as it is created, before you have been paid. This leaves you without your IP rights if the client fails to pay.
findings.suggested_change: Work Product, and every right in it, shall vest in the Client upon full payment of the applicable fees for such Work Product.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a minor adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on work product ownership, the current wording transfers rights as the work is generated before payment is received, leaving my IP unprotected if payment fails. I propose modifying this so that work product vests in the client upon full payment of the applicable fees. Thank you, and I look forward to moving forward.
